{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/parallel-processing\n\n# Parallel Processing with joblib\n\nSpeed up computationally intensive tasks by distributing work across multiple CPU cores.\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n```python\nfrom joblib import Parallel, delayed\n\ndef process_item(x):\n    \"\"\"Process a single item.\"\"\"\n    return x ** 2\n\n# Sequential\nresults = [process_item(x) for x in range(100)]\n\n# Parallel (uses all available cores)\nresults = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(\n    delayed(process_item)(x) for x in range(100)\n)\n```\n\n## Key Parameters\n\n- **n_jobs**: `-1` for all cores, `1` for sequential, or specific number\n- **verbose**: `0` (silent), `10` (progress), `50` (detailed)\n- **backend**: `'loky'` (CPU-bound, default) or `'threading'` (I/O-bound)\n\n## Grid Search Example\n\n```python\nfrom joblib import Parallel, delayed\nfrom itertools import product\n\ndef evaluate_params(param_a, param_b):\n    \"\"\"Evaluate one parameter combination.\"\"\"\n    score = expensive_computation(param_a, param_b)\n    return {'param_a': param_a, 'param_b': param_b, 'score': score}\n\n# Define parameter grid\nparams = list(product([0.1, 0.5, 1.0], [10, 20, 30]))\n\n# Parallel grid search\nresults = Parallel(n_jobs=-1, verbose=10)(\n    delayed(evaluate_params)(a, b) for a, b in params\n)\n\n# Filter results\nresults = [r for r in results if r is not None]\nbest = max(results, key=lambda x: x['score'])\n```\n\n## Pre-computing Shared Data\n\nWhen all tasks need the same data, pre-compute it once:\n\n```python\n# Pre-compute once\nshared_data = load_data()\n\ndef process_with_shared(params, data):\n    return compute(params, data)\n\n# Pass shared data to each task\nresults = Parallel(n_jobs=-1)(\n    delayed(process_with_shared)(p, shared_data)\n    for p in param_list\n)\n```\n\n## Performance Tips\n\n- Only worth it for tasks taking >0.1s per item (overhead cost)\n- Watch memory usage - each worker gets a copy of data\n- Use `verbose=10` to monitor progress\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"50c9fdb6-53b4-4eb5-bafe-5f34049b0651","uuid":"276371e5-f5ff-4d98-9d53-527d6046c886","timestamp":"2026-03-18T05:30:40.308Z","isSynthetic":true}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /logs/agent/sessions/skills/pareto-optimization\n\n# Pareto Optimization\n\nPareto optimization deals with multi-objective optimization where you want to optimize multiple conflicting objectives simultaneously.\n\n## Key Concepts\n\n### Pareto Dominance\n\nPoint A **dominates** point B if:\n- A is at least as good as B in all objectives\n- A is strictly better than B in at least one objective\n\n### Pareto Frontier (Pareto Front)\n\nThe set of all non-dominated points. These represent optimal trade-offs where improving one objective requires sacrificing another.\n\n## Computing the Pareto Frontier\n\n### Using the paretoset Library\n\n```python\nfrom paretoset import paretoset\nimport pandas as pd\n\n# Data with two objectives (e.g., model accuracy vs inference time)\ndf = pd.DataFrame({\n    'accuracy': [0.95, 0.92, 0.88, 0.85, 0.80],\n    'latency_ms': [120, 95, 75, 60, 45],\n    'model_size': [100, 80, 60, 40, 20],\n    'learning_rate': [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1]\n})\n\n# Compute Pareto mask\n# sense: \"max\" for objectives to maximize, \"min\" for objectives to minimize\nobjectives = df[['accuracy', 'latency_ms']]\npareto_mask = paretoset(objectives, sense=[\"max\", \"min\"])\n\n# Get Pareto-optimal points\npareto_points = df[pareto_mask]\n```\n\n### Manual Implementation\n\n```python\nimport numpy as np\n\ndef is_dominated(point, other_points, maximize_indices, minimize_indices):\n    \"\"\"Check if point is dominated by any point in other_points.\"\"\"\n    for other in other_points:\n        dominated = True\n        strictly_worse = False\n\n        for i in maximize_indices:\n            if point[i] > other[i]:\n                dominated = False\n                break\n            if point[i] < other[i]:\n                strictly_worse = True\n\n        if dominated:\n            for i in minimize_indices:\n                if point[i] < other[i]:\n                    dominated = False\n                    break\n                if point[i] > other[i]:\n                    strictly_worse = True\n\n        if dominated and strictly_worse:\n            return True\n\n    return False\n\ndef compute_pareto_frontier(points, maximize_indices=[0], minimize_indices=[1]):\n    \"\"\"Compute Pareto frontier from array of points.\"\"\"\n    pareto = []\n    points_list = list(points)\n\n    for i, point in enumerate(points_list):\n        others = points_list[:i] + points_list[i+1:]\n        if not is_dominated(point, others, maximize_indices, minimize_indices):\n            pareto.append(point)\n\n    return np.array(pareto)\n```\n\n## Example: Model Selection\n\n```python\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom paretoset import paretoset\n\n# Results from model training experiments\nresults = pd.DataFrame({\n    'accuracy': [0.95, 0.92, 0.90, 0.88, 0.85],\n    'inference_time': [150, 120, 100, 80, 60],\n    'batch_size': [32, 64, 128, 256, 512],\n    'hidden_units': [512, 256, 128, 64, 32]\n})\n\n# Filter by minimum accuracy threshold\nresults = results[results['accuracy'] >= 0.85]\n\n# Compute Pareto frontier (maximize accuracy, minimize inference time)\nmask = paretoset(results[['accuracy', 'inference_time']], sense=[\"max\", \"min\"])\npareto_frontier = results[mask].sort_values('accuracy', ascending=False)\n\n# Save to CSV\npareto_frontier.to_csv('pareto_models.csv', index=False)\n```\n\n## Visualization\n\n```python\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\n# Plot all points\nplt.scatter(results['inference_time'], results['accuracy'],\n            alpha=0.5, label='All models')\n\n# Highlight Pareto frontier\nplt.scatter(pareto_frontier['inference_time'], pareto_frontier['accuracy'],\n            color='red', s=100, marker='s', label='Pareto frontier')\n\nplt.xlabel('Inference Time (ms) - minimize')\nplt.ylabel('Accuracy - maximize')\nplt.legend()\nplt.show()\n```\n\n## Properties of Pareto Frontiers\n\n1. **Trade-off curve**: Moving along the frontier improves one objective while worsening another\n2. **No single best**: All Pareto-optimal solutions are equally \"good\" in a multi-objective sense\n3. **Decision making**: Final choice depends on preference between objectives\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"50c9fdb6-53b4-4eb5-bafe-5f34049b0651","uuid":"3eeaf414-6d79-4076-84a0-434f3a3acbc7","timestamp":"2026-03-18T05:30:42.222Z","isSynthetic":true}

Precompute custom distance matrices for all images once\n    dist_matrices = {}\n    for img in expert_images:\n        pts = citsci_by_image.get(img)\n        if pts is not None and len(pts) > 0:\n            dx = np.abs(w * (pts[:, 0][:, None] - pts[:, 0][None, :]))\n            dy = np.abs((2 - w) * (pts[:, 1][:, None] - pts[:, 1][None, :]))\n            dist_matrices[img] = dx + dy\n\n    results = []\n    for min_samples in min_samples_list:\n        for epsilon in epsilon_list:\n            f1_scores = []\n            delta_values = []\n\n            for img in expert_images:\n                expert_pts = expert_by_image.get(img)\n                if expert_pts is None or len(expert_pts) == 0:\n                    f1_scores.append(0.0)\n                    continue\n\n                dist_matrix = dist_matrices.get(img)\n                if dist_matrix is None:\n                    # No citizen science points for this image\n                    f1_scores.append(0.0)\n                    continue\n\n                citsci_pts = citsci_by_image[img]\n\n                # Run DBSCAN with precomputed custom distance matrix\n                db = DBSCAN(eps=epsilon, min_samples=min_samples, metric='precomputed')\n                labels = db.fit_predict(dist_matrix)\n\n                unique_labels = set(labels) - {-1}\n\n                if len(unique_labels) == 0:\n                    f1_scores.append(0.0)\n                    continue\n\n                # Compute cluster centroids (in original x,y space)\n                centroids = np.array([\n                    citsci_pts[labels == lbl].mean(axis=0)\n                    for lbl in unique_labels\n                ])\n\n                # Greedy matching: Euclidean distance, max 100px\n                n_c = len(centroids)\n                n_e = len(expert_pts)\n                euclid = np.sqrt(\n                    ((centroids[:, None, :] - expert_pts[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2)\n                )  # shape (n_c, n_e)\n\n                # Build sorted list of (dist, centroid_idx, expert_idx)\n                pairs = sorted(\n                    [(euclid[i, j], i, j) for i in range(n_c) for j in range(n_e)]\n                )\n\n                matched_c = set()\n                matched_e = set()\n                match_dists = []\n                for dist, i, j in pairs:\n                    if dist > 100:\n                        break\n                    if i not in matched_c and j not in matched_e:\n                        matched_c.add(i)\n                        matched_e.add(j)\n                        match_dists.append(dist)\n\n                n_match = len(match_dists)\n                if n_match == 0:\n                    f1_scores.append(0.0)\n                    continue\n\n                tp = n_match\n                fp = n_c - n_match\n                fn = n_e - n_match\n\n                precision = tp / (tp + fp)\n                recall = tp / (tp + fn)\n                f1 = (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)\n                      if (precision + recall) > 0 else 0.0)\n\n                f1_scores.append(f1)\n                delta_values.append(float(np.mean(match_dists)))\n\n            avg_f1 = float(np.mean(f1_scores))\n            avg_delta = float(np.mean(delta_values)) if delta_values else float('nan')\n\n            results.append({\n                'F1': avg_f1,\n                'delta': avg_delta,\n                'min_samples': int(min_samples),\n                'epsilon': int(epsilon),\n                'shape_weight': round(float(shape_weight), 1),\n            })\n\n    return results\n\n\n# Parameter grids\nmin_samples_list = list(range(3, 10))           # 3..9\nepsilon_list = list(range(4, 25, 2))            # 4,6,...,24\nshape_weight_list = [round(0.9 + 0.1 * i, 1) for i in range(11)]  # 0.9..1.9\n\ntotal = len(min_samples_list) * len(epsilon_list) * len(shape_weight_list)\nprint(f\"Total combinations: {total}\")\n\n# Parallelise over shape_weight (11 jobs); each job precomputes distance matrices once\nall_results = Parallel(n_jobs=-1, verbose=5)(\n    delayed(evaluate_shape_weight)(\n        sw, min_samples_list, epsilon_list,\n        expert_images, citsci_by_image, expert_by_image\n    )\n    for sw in shape_weight_list\n)\n\n# Flatten\nresults_flat = [r for sublist in all_results for r in sublist]\ndf = pd.DataFrame(results_flat)\n\nprint(f\"\\nAll results: {len(df)}\")\nprint(f\"F1 stats: min={df['F1'].min():.4f}, max={df['F1'].max():.4f}, mean={df['F1'].mean():.4f}\")\n\n# Filter: F1 > 0.5 and delta not NaN\ndf = df[df['F1'] > 0.5].dropna(subset=['delta']).reset_index(drop=True)\nprint(f\"After F1>0.5 filter: {len(df)}\")\n\n# Compute Pareto frontier (maximize F1, minimize delta)\ntry:\n    from paretoset import paretoset\n    mask = paretoset(df[['F1', 'delta']], sense=[\"max\", \"min\"])\n    pareto_df = df[mask].copy()\nexcept ImportError:\n    # Manual Pareto computation\n    def is_pareto_efficient(costs):\n        \"\"\"costs[:,0] = -F1 (minimize), costs[:,1] = delta (minimize)\"\"\"\n        n = len(costs)\n        is_efficient = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)\n        for i in range(n):\n            if is_efficient[i]:\n                # dominated if someone is <= in all and < in at least one\n                dominated = np.all(costs <= costs[i], axis=1) & np.any(costs < costs[i], axis=1)\n                is_efficient[dominated] = False\n                is_efficient[i] = True  # keep self\n        return is_efficient\n\n    costs = df[['F1', 'delta']].values.copy()\n    costs[:, 0] = -costs[:, 0]  # negate F1 to minimise\n    mask = is_pareto_efficient(costs)\n    pareto_df = df[mask].copy()\n\n# Format and save\npareto_df['F1'] = pareto_df['F1'].round(5)\npareto_df['delta'] = pareto_df['delta'].round(5)\npareto_df['shape_weight'] = pareto_df['shape_weight'].round(1)\npareto_df['min_samples'] = pareto_df['min_samples'].astype(int)\npareto_df['epsilon'] = pareto_df['epsilon'].astype(int)\n\npareto_df = pareto_df[['F1', 'delta', 'min_samples', 'epsilon', 'shape_weight']]\npareto_df = pareto_df.sort_values('F1', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)\n\npareto_df.to_csv('/root/pareto_frontier.csv', index=False)\nprint(f\"\\nPareto frontier: {len(pareto_df)} points\")\nprint(pareto_df.to_string())\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1266,"cache_read_input_tokens":21658,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1266,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"50c9fdb6-53b4-4eb5-bafe-5f34049b0651","uuid":"8cd01a27-1d7f-4faa-8f7d-96d83ca19181"}
